'''2001 New Jersey State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in New Jersey in 2001. [[Michael L. Dalton]] won it.<ref name="dt-16095">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16095 Dalton's Hidden Mains], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" L. Dalton, 21 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16095/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16095/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 21 May)
* '''Site:''' New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael L. Dalton]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

| 1st || [[Michael L. Dalton]]<ref name="dt-16095" /> || — || [[2001 New Jersey State Championship Michael L. Dalton Dalton's Hidden Mains|Hidden Base mains]]
|}

Dalton won with a Hidden Base mains deck. His posted list is an improved version: since States he took out Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, two Ben Kenobi and the Tatooine docking bay, and put in a second Luke's Lightsaber, two more EPP Obi-Wans and the Endor docking bay.<ref name="dt-16095" />
